job.title: Customer Sales Consultant
job.description:
S2M is partnering with a fast-growing Australian clean-energy business and they're looking for an experienced Customer Sales Consultant to join its growing Sydney team. You'll manage inbound enquiries, build customer relationships and convert qualified leads into sign-ups for an innovative solar and battery solution.
  
What You'll Be Doing
  • Manage inbound enquiries and convert qualified leads into trial sign-ups.
  • Build customer trust, understand needs and overcome objections.
  • Manage high-volume sales activity, follow-ups and pipeline conversion.
  • Consistently achieve sales targets and conversion KPIs.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records and identify opportunities to improve sales processes.
What We're Looking For
  • 4+ years of phone-based, inside or consultative sales experience.
  • Working in a Start-Up or Early-Stage environment is highly desirable
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong lead qualification, objection handling and closing skills.
  • Experience managing high-volume pipelines and using Salesforce or similar CRMs.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building and organisational skills.
  • Energy, solar, telco, insurance or finance experience highly regarded; Mandarin a bonus.
Ready to turn great conversations into real results? If you're a proven sales performer who enjoys helping customers, smashing targets and working with an innovative business, we'd love to hear from you!

Apply now or send your CV to brett@s2m.com.au / muneera@s2m.com.au for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Group SEO Lead
job.description:
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Group SEO Lead to lead a high-performing SEO capability within a leading global media organisation.

This is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing SEO strategy, client delivery, commercial performance and specialist team development across Melbourne and Sydney. Working closely with the Head of SEO, you'll play a pivotal role in strengthening the SEO function as a centre of excellence, driving innovation, improving operational performance and delivering sustainable commercial growth.

What you'll be doing:
  • Lead and develop a team of Directors and Associate Directors across Melbourne and Sydney. Foster a collaborative, high-performing team culture focused on professional development, accountability and client success.
  • Oversee SEO strategy, client delivery and performance across major client portfolios.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior clients, providing strategic guidance and acting as a key escalation point. Collaborate with senior leadership to develop and evolve SEO products, services and commercial offerings.
  • Manage commercial performance, including revenue forecasting, profitability, client scopes and renewals. Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through strategic partnerships, scope expansion and new SEO solutions.
  • Work closely with agency teams, performance specialists and technology partners to integrate SEO into broader media strategies.
What We're Looking For:
This opportunity requires an experienced SEO and digital leader with the ability to balance strategic client relationships, commercial accountability, people leadership and operational excellence.
  • Extensive experience across SEO, organic search strategy and digital performance within an agency or media environment. Strong understanding of SEO product development and its integration into broader media and marketing strategies.
  • Proven experience leading and developing senior specialists, Directors or Associate Directors across multiple teams or locations.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including revenue forecasting, profitability management, client scopes and account growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex client portfolios and build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience improving operational processes, delivery standards, team structures and quality frameworks.
Why Join?
This is an opportunity to take on a highly influential leadership role within a globally recognised media network, with the ability to shape SEO capability, commercial strategy and team performance across multiple markets.

You'll work alongside experienced industry leaders, access an extensive global network of expertise and technology, and play a key role in developing innovative search solutions for major brands.

Apply now or send your CV to brett@s2m.com.au or contact us on 02 8396 6800 for a confidential discussion.

job.title: SEO Manager
job.description:
An exciting opportunity has opened for an SEO Manager to join a leading global media and digital organisation in Sydney.

This is a senior operational and client leadership opportunity overseeing SEO, generative search, analytics and reporting workstreams. You’ll translate strategy into delivery, lead specialist teams and work closely with senior stakeholders to maintain strong client performance and grow Experience services.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Lead day-to-day client relationships across key accounts.
  • Oversee SEO, generative search, analytics and reporting workstreams.
  • Manage and develop Managers, Executives and other specialists.
  • Coach teams and support performance, progression and capability development.
  • Manage resourcing and utilisation across multiple client portfolios.
  • Ensure delivery remains aligned with client KPIs, scopes and deadlines.
  • Monitor project profitability, revenue, invoicing and third-party costs.
  • Identify efficiencies and opportunities to improve commercial performance.
  • Support pitches, scoping, proposals and new-business opportunities.
  • Improve workflows, reporting frameworks and scalable delivery processes.
What We’re Looking For
You’ll be an experienced search, SEO or digital Experience leader who can confidently operate across clients, teams, commercial management and delivery. We’re particularly interested in candidates with:
  • Strong SEO, technical search and digital performance expertise.
  • Knowledge of generative/AI search and emerging search behaviours.
  • Experience leading significant client relationships.
  • Proven people management and capability-development experience.
  • Experience managing workloads and resources across multiple accounts.
  • Experience supporting pitches, proposals or account growth.
  • Strong analytics and reporting capability.
  • The ability to influence senior clients and internal stakeholders.
This is a great opportunity for a senior SEO specialist ready to step into broader leadership responsibility.

Apply now or send your CV to brett@s2m.com.au or contact us at 02 8396 6800 for a confidential discussion.
